method.blinding: Independent writer read root README and docs/architecture.md only before authoring; no product source, tests, existing benchmark cases or gold. README disclosed prior examples/aggregate results. All 40 expectations were hand-authored and pushed before interface inspection and inference.
method.single_run: One compiler invocation and at most one DeepSeek HTTP request per case; four concurrent workers; both provider and transport attempt limits one; no fallback, repairs, reruns or tuning. All raw records saved before gold scoring.
method.runtime: Unmodified real pipeline imported from a temporary git archive of the freeze revision to isolate concurrent repo edits. Compiler receives original policy only. Compiled policy is the only policy supplied to the deterministic app analysis.
method.input_scope: Text policy compilation plus mechanical schema normalization of independently supplied EOB, bill, contract allowance and opening accumulators. This does not evaluate PDF/OCR or automatic raw-document extraction.
method.fact_limitations: Narrative clinical/legal/coding facts are retained in claim descriptions and literal confirmation strings. No hand-written benefit corrections, category inference, legal protection override, duplicate removal or semantic mapping of compiled condition labels. Unsupported cases can block or fail; they stay in denominators.
method.exact: Nonconditional answer within 100 cents inclusive, denominator 40; range results are not exact answers. Patient responsibility is pre-payment liability; remaining balance is separately reported.
method.range: Inclusive illustrative scenario extrema, no tolerance; rate denominator is range cases. Also report point/range containment over all 40. Scenario endpoints are not proven exhaustive bounds.
method.abstain: Needs clarification or error / 40. A separate without-confirmed-answer rate includes conditional ranges.
method.detection: Only nonconditional answers yield a binary flag. An explicit per-line total patient difference versus EOB or statement establishes a flag; component reallocations alone do not. Failed positive cases count as FN; failed negatives abstain, not TN. Precision TP/(TP+FP), recall TP/24, FPR FP/16, resolved-negative coverage separately. Null indicates a zero denominator.
method.billed_comparison: List predictions above statement patient-paid-plus-balance, and separately above gross charges. Also retain remaining-balance comparisons. Some gold cases intentionally underbill, so a higher prediction is not automatically incorrect.

request_config.evidence_spans: selected original source lines with local offsets; legacy quotes use whitespace-normalized search

run_metadata.adapter: Frozen observation fields translated mechanically; narrative facts retained without clinical/legal inference.
